name: Premier Inn Scarborough (North Bay)
accommodation: Double, twin, family and accessible rooms
suitableFor: Couples, families and short stopovers wanting a simple, central base
parking: Council-owned pay-and-display car park (free 1 Nov to 1 Mar)
beachAccess: Less than a mile from Scarborough beach
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, Thyme Bar & Grill restaurant, breakfast, accessible rooms
overview: A modern Premier Inn on the North Bay side of Scarborough, under a mile from the beach and close to Peasholm Park and the castle headland. Rooms come as doubles, twins, family and accessible options, with breakfast and dinner served in the on-site bar and grill.
surfTripFit: A no-fuss, predictable base for checking North Bay at first light, with on-site food after a session.
